entries.femaleVariant: Knew they used people. Did not know they used the people. I was told the implants carried encrypted noise, useless without a paired key.
entries.maleVariant: Knew they used people. Did not know they used the people. I was told the implants carried encrypted noise, useless without a paired key.

entries.femaleVariant: I believed not asking kept the route cheap and me alive. Dress it up however you want. Still the truth.
entries.maleVariant: I believed not asking kept the route cheap and me alive. Dress it up however you want. Still the truth.

entries.femaleVariant: I have a van at the safe site. Registry will clear the interchange's first scan. After that, we improvise in person.
entries.maleVariant: I have a van at the safe site. Registry will clear the interchange's first scan. After that, we improvise in person.

entries.femaleVariant: Van belongs to a plumbing cooperative that has never fixed a pipe. Try not to add traffic violations to its business model.
entries.maleVariant: Van belongs to a plumbing cooperative that has never fixed a pipe. Try not to add traffic violations to its business model.

entries.femaleVariant: How many courier runs did you touch?
entries.maleVariant: How many courier runs did you touch?

entries.femaleVariant: Four sealed cases. Two dead drops. No names.
entries.maleVariant: Four sealed cases. Two dead drops. No names.

entries.femaleVariant: Quiet Spine paid for ignorance by the kilometre. Thought that made me outside the thing.
entries.maleVariant: Quiet Spine paid for ignorance by the kilometre. Thought that made me outside the thing.

entries.femaleVariant: It made you useful to it.
entries.maleVariant: It made you useful to it.

entries.femaleVariant: Zero-Seven-B is the refrigerated box truck. Route badge under the left mirror. Driver should be inside arguing about the alarm you definitely did not trigger.
entries.maleVariant: Zero-Seven-B is the refrigerated box truck. Route badge under the left mirror. Driver should be inside arguing about the alarm you definitely did not trigger.

entries.femaleVariant: Driver thinks the schedule changed. We still have a quiet window.
entries.maleVariant: Driver thinks the schedule changed. We still have a quiet window.

entries.femaleVariant: Driver knows the route is burned. Window's closed; we're going through it anyway.
entries.maleVariant: Driver knows the route is burned. Window's closed; we're going through it anyway.

entries.femaleVariant: Beacon is moving. Relay is south. I'll wipe the van and find another way there.
entries.maleVariant: Beacon is moving. Relay is south. I'll wipe the van and find another way there.
